summary: A 23-year-old man from Pueblo drowned in Willow Creek at Curecanti National Recreation Area; rangers dispatched on a morning report of a struggling swimmer arrived within minutes, but he had slipped under the surface; his body was retrieved from about 10 feet of water, CPR and advanced life support were continued during transport to Gunnison Valley Hospital, and he did not survive.
location: Willow Creek, Curecanti National Recreation Area
responding_agency: NPS rangers; Gunnison County Sheriff's Office
notes: NPS morning-report 2011-08-02 entry (incident Thursday 2011-07-28); joint NPS + Gunnison County SO investigation.
